description: Start a new search for potential customers of the user's business: recent public posts by people who are asking for, or want to buy, what the business sells. Only for finding new customers when the user asks for that; it does not list or rank leads the user already has. A search saves a campaign in the user's EvenLeads account, uses one search from their plan and takes one to three minutes. Takes a plain description of the business (and its website if known) and returns a search id right away with the first results as they arrive. The user must be signed in with EvenLeads.

business.description: What the business sells and to whom, in the user's own words. One to three sentences is enough.

campaign_id.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to run a new search on one of their existing campaigns, by its campaign id. Not for showing that campaign's leads.

ideal_customers.description: Optional: who the best customers are (industry, size, situation).

website.description: The business website, if the user gave one.

name: find_customers

reason.description: Why this post matches the business.

id.description: Search id, used to check the progress of this search.

title: Find customers for a business
